protocol: Render one lightweight HumanML3D-style skeleton MP4 per baseline per Original100 full-text prompt.
motion_source: MotionGPT demo outputs, MoLingo joints, MoMask original joints, MoGenTS custom-direct joints.
coverage: Original100 four-baseline diagnostic visualization; 100 prompts per baseline when limit=0.
limitations: Skeleton visualization for qualitative inspection only; not a held-out final evaluator; All videos use a Matplotlib-compatibility copy of the MoMask/HumanML3D plot_3d_motion renderer; MoGenTS remains a custom direct runner artifact; MoLingo run_manifest has legacy metadata text.
